_comment: The voice actions of each app: one list read by src/voice.ts (the screens) and plugins/withDajiVoice.js (Siri App Shortcuts, Android shortcuts). phrase uses APP for the app's name (Apple requires it); personal uses NAME for the assistant name the person picked. An action asks `question`, or opens `screen`.

staff.title: What needs my attention
staff.phrase: Ask APP what needs my attention
staff.personal: Tell NAME what needs my attention
staff.question: What is waiting for approval?

staff.title: Today's bookings
staff.personal: Tell NAME to show today's bookings
staff.question: What's booked for today?

staff.title: Payments to check
staff.phrase: Ask APP which payments need checking
staff.personal: Tell NAME which payments need checking
staff.question: Which payments are waiting to be checked?

staff.title: Today's revenue
staff.personal: Tell NAME to show today's revenue
staff.question: What was the revenue today?

staff.title: Who owes us money
staff.phrase: Ask APP who owes us money
staff.personal: Tell NAME who owes us money
staff.question: Who still owes us money?

staff.title: WhatsApp messages to review
staff.phrase: Ask APP what is new on WhatsApp
staff.personal: Tell NAME what is new on WhatsApp
staff.question: What is in the WhatsApp inbox?

staff.title: Create a task
staff.personal: Tell NAME to create a task

staff.title: Enter a cash spend
staff.phrase: Enter a cash spend in APP

customer.title: My next booking
customer.phrase: Ask APP when my next booking is
customer.question: When is my next booking?

customer.title: Is the ground free today

customer.personal: Ask NAME if the ground is free today
customer.question: Is the cricket ground free today?

customer.title: My credit

customer.question: How much credit do I have?

customer.title: My games and tier
customer.phrase: Ask APP how many games I have played

customer.title: Live score

customer.title: Book a slot

customer.title: Hosted tournaments
